test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Five persons, A, B, C, D, E, are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center. 

1) A is the neighbour of E and D.

2) B is the second to the left of D.

Who is to the immediate right of B?
solution:
1) A is the neighbour of E and D.

**Case 1:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/669c8ab0ae16c85fe8e1f3c017fba2c697a95be5ccfa920d4d8eec34b4c7510b.png] 

**Case 2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1199a7b3c00005a0b1a2dffb0f270c2f7a60b7dcbd545f0d7810d14681893d70.png] 

2) B is the second to the left of D.

Case 2 - In this, the position of second to the left of D is not vacant than how can B placed there.

Therefore the Case 2 will not be applicable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f980fcff21fc453ce5dd22ade8ff1f886302c5087dcf7f2d5288614f0eba6c6.png] 

The final position

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/409cbd0c8445d303373417010887fb4b537795c9bf3045f9751f346006eb8935.png] 

Immediate right of B is 'C'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**
